mapper.sql: b.id, b.batch_name, b.honor_type, b.academic_year, b.eval_term, b.quota, b.quota_note, b.criteria, b.materials, b.apply_start, b.apply_end, b.review_end, b.publicity_days, b.publicity_start, b.publicity_end, b.status, b.notice_title, b.notice_url, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS created_by_name
FROM honor_batch b LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.created_by AND u.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (b.batch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.academic_year LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO honor_batch (batch_name, honor_type, academic_year, eval_term, quota, quota_note, criteria, materials, apply_start, apply_end, review_end, publicity_days, status, notice_title, notice_url, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchName}, #{honorType}, #{academicYear}, #{evalTerm}, #{quota}, #{quotaNote}, #{criteria}, #{materials}, #{applyStart}, #{applyEnd}, #{reviewEnd}, #{publicityDays}, #{status}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeUrl}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE b.deleted = 0
ORDER BY FIELD(b.status, 'recruiting', 'reviewing', 'publicity', 'draft', 'finished'), b.apply_end IS NULL, b.apply_end DESC, b.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE honor_batch SET batch_name = #{batch.batchName}, honor_type = #{batch.honorType}, academic_year = #{batch.academicYear}, eval_term = #{batch.evalTerm}, quota = #{batch.quota}, quota_note = #{batch.quotaNote}, criteria = #{batch.criteria}, materials = #{batch.materials}, apply_start = #{batch.applyStart}, apply_end = #{batch.applyEnd}, review_end = #{batch.reviewEnd}, publicity_days = #{batch.publicityDays}, notice_title = #{batch.noticeTitle}, notice_url = #{batch.noticeUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{batch.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE honor_batch SET status = 'publicity', publicity_days = #{publicityDays}, publicity_start = #{publicityStart}, publicity_end = #{publicityEnd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE honor_batch SET status = 'reviewing', updated_at = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'recruiting' AND apply_end IS NOT NULL AND apply_end < CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM honor_batch WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
